theme: The ROI Number No One Puts in the Board Deck

linkedin.text:
The metric that most justifies an incentive travel budget is almost never in the post-event deck.

Cost per head: tracked to the last decimal.
Revenue attribution from the sales team you just rewarded: sometimes.
Retention rate in the 12 months following the program: almost never.

Here's why that gap is expensive.

Replacing a mid-to-senior employee typically costs somewhere between half and twice their annual salary — depending on role, industry and how long the seat stays empty. An incentive program that keeps three of those people engaged and present for one more year doesn't look like a line item. It looks like the best-returning room you ever booked.

We've designed and produced incentive programs for 25,000+ participants across 130+ destinations over 16 years. The clients who measure what the program prevented — not just what it cost — are consistently the ones who expand it when budgets tighten, instead of cutting it first.

If you're currently scoping an incentive program and want to see the framework we use to model this for a specific team size — comment below or send me a message.

facebook.text:
There's one number missing from almost every post-event report after an incentive trip.

Not cost per head. Everyone tracks that.

The number nobody captures: the retention rate of the people in the room in the 12 months that follow.

An incentive trip gets evaluated on what it cost. Almost never on what it prevented — the resignation letter drafted at midnight, the LinkedIn message from a competitor that finally got a reply, the quiet exit that cost far more than the trip ever would have.

We've produced incentive programs for 25,000+ participants across 130+ destinations. The leaders who come back and scale the program aren't doing it on sentiment. They're doing it because they ran the numbers and the numbers held.

If you're making the internal case for next year's incentive budget and want to see the ROI framework we share with clients — drop a comment or send us a message. We'll send it straight over. 📊
